firm_data.firm_description: Watson Farley & Williams is an international law firm with expertise and industry insight across the energy, infrastructure and transport sectors. They advise on complex, high-value transactions and disputes, combining legal analysis with commercial awareness.
notable_facts: Founded in 1982 as a ship and aviation finance boutique.
The firm has 19 offices across the globe.

email.subject: AI for Watson Farley & Williams, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Lindsey,

Watson Farley & Williams has built something rare: deep expertise across energy, infrastructure, and transport while competing globally across 19 offices. That combination of sector focus and scale is exactly what caught our attention.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in London to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on complex transactions and disputes.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
